test_title: PYST 35: Selection Post (Matric Level) - Quant (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: On what sum of money will the difference between simple interest and compound interest for 2 years at 10% per annum be equal to Rs.250?
solution:
**Given:**

Difference between CI and SI = Rs 250

Time = 2 years

Rate = 10% p.a.

**Concept Used:**

Simple Interest = P × R × T / 100

Compound Interest = P(1+(r)/(100))^t – P

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the principal amount be Rs x.

⇒ SI = (xtimes 10times 2)/(100)=(x)/(5)

⇒ CI = x(1+(10)/(100))² – x = x × (11)/(10) × (11)/(10) – x = (121x-100x)/(100)=(21x)/(100)

⇒ CI – SI = (21x)/(100)-(x)/(5)=(21x-20x)/(100)=(x)/(100)

⇒ According to the question,

⇒ (x)/(100) = 250

⇒ x = 250 × 100 = 25,000

**Therefore, the sum of money equals to Rs 25,000.**
